description: A question about the workspace's sites in plain words ("Which site lost the most traffic this week and why?", "Which board grew fastest?"), answered by Lookout only from its own figures: one sentence with the key number, up to three supporting points, the most relevant site, and, when it compares several sites or boards, a small chart. scope workspace reads every board (sites counted once); scope board reads one board.

board.description: For scope board: the board's id or name

anyOf.description: A custom window of whole UTC days, 1 to 30 days, ending today at the latest

range.description: 24h, 7d or 30d, or a custom window { "from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "to": "YYYY-MM-DD" } (UTC days, up to 30). Default 7d.

scope.description: workspace: every board; board: one board (needs board)

name: ask_lookout
title: Ask Lookout
